compiled_state.description:
## Context / Problem

The preserved AWS review-bot clone contains structured code-review telemetry stranded by the intentional tickets-history rewrite. Operational correctness does not require it because Gerrit retains the votes, but the seven REVIEW_RESULT payloads contain audit detail not guaranteed to remain in Gerrit. The operator authorized an exact selective transplant before quiet-window closeout.

## Approach

At source HEAD 376bc29eadd42f9bb4335f4e365bf53119bb41d3, derive a content-hashed allowlist from the diff against tracking ref 9ffd0f8ed06d458e54192cbc05d4ff391f49a58e. Accept exactly five CREATE, seven REVIEW_RESULT, and nine LINK events. Require every CREATE to be code_review. Six artifacts receive review results: five are created by this batch, while pre-existing code_review artifact e1c8-5b78-948f-41cc receives one additional sidecar. Require every LINK to be a bidirectional relates_to edge between a new artifact and an existing implementation ticket. Reject ENQUEUE_ENRICH, CLAIM_ENRICH, DONE_ENRICH, any removed comment alias, path collision, or extra event.

Use rebar._store.event_append.batch_write_and_push (src/rebar/_store/event_append.py) against the recreated live review-bot store. That canonical writer validates fully composed events, stages all 21 atomically under the unified ticket lock, commits one path-scoped batch, and uses the normal tickets push/reconvergence path. src/rebar/_store/event_prepare.py serializes the supplied event dictionaries without re-deriving timestamp, UUID, author, environment, or signature, preserving the signed source bytes while avoiding any merge of the 399 divergent commits.

## Scope

No codebase files change. The mutation is limited to the 21 allowlisted event paths, one canonical batch event commit, and private off-repository manifest/verification receipts; normal push reconvergence may add a merge commit if another ticket writer advances origin concurrently. The preserved source clone remains read-only. All 66 enrichment events, the untracked stale DONE_ENRICH, removed comment material, and divergent git ancestry are excluded.

## Testing

- Preflight: compute the source allowlist and SHA-256 manifest twice; require equal digests, exact type counts, valid artifact ownership/link targets, valid event filenames, and zero target-path collisions at the current authoritative tip.
- Failure path: run the validator with one excluded enrichment path and require refusal before the canonical writer is called.
- Rehearsal: apply the exact batch to a disposable clone at the current epoch, then require strict fsck, reducer visibility of five new code-review artifacts plus the pre-existing e1c8 artifact, seven sidecars, nine links, valid authorship, and a tree delta containing only the 21 paths.
- Live: revalidate the source and target immediately before batch_write_and_push, capture the current origin OID, publish through the canonical writer, and verify from a fresh clone. Re-run the 1,520 removed-alias oracle and the Jira cleanup observation to prove non-resurrection.
- Back-out: if post-publication verification fails, use event_append.delete_events to append one path-scoped revert commit deleting exactly the 21 manifest paths, push normally without reset or force, and verify removal from a fresh clone while preserving any concurrent ticket events.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] [non-codebase] A signed-content manifest identifies exactly 21 source events with counts CREATE=5, REVIEW_RESULT=7, LINK=9 and no enrichment event; checked by two equal SHA-256 calculations recorded on this ticket.
- [ ] [non-codebase] A disposable current-epoch rehearsal has only the 21-path additive delta and passes strict fsck, reducer, authorship, and link-target checks; the candidate tip and receipt digest are recorded on this ticket.
- [ ] [non-codebase] The authoritative store contains five new code-review artifacts, seven transplanted structured review results across six artifacts, and nine bidirectional relates_to events after one canonical batch write; checked from a fresh clone and recorded with the publication OID.
- [ ] [non-codebase] No removed echo material or stale enrichment work is restored; checked by 0/1,520 removed aliases, unchanged Jira cleanup observation, and an authoritative enrichment-state comparison recorded on this ticket.
- [ ] [non-codebase] The forensic source clone remains at HEAD 376bc29eadd42f9bb4335f4e365bf53119bb41d3 with its untracked DONE_ENRICH preserved; checked by post-operation read-only status recorded on this ticket.
